author: bardic-inspiration
name: Tower Shield of Patience
summary: A shield that grants extra cover to a defender who stands their ground.
description: The face is painted with an eye that has been repainted so many times it looks stern. Gatekeepers treasure it.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wielding this shield (in addition to the shield's normal bonus). If you take the Dodge action, the bonus becomes +2 until the start of your next turn.
